title: Stress Relief
lyrics:
[00:27.93]I never thought you'd end up with me for long, baby
[00:35.00]Running in quicksand to keep you here with me
[00:41.85]I had you in my head, baby, every day
[00:45.19]But towards the end, I just couldn't hear your name
[00:48.61]It's stress relief from everything
[01:02.23]It's stress relief from everything
[01:08.44]Tell me, tell me you love me
[01:11.94]Come back, come back to haunt me
[01:15.36]Won't you, won't you let me be myself?
[01:22.63]I was holding on, but you didn't see my shots, baby
[01:29.94]All the times that I couldn't speak my thoughts, well, maybe
[01:36.57]Well, this is what I wanted, please don't feel so bad
[01:40.03]In love with a ghost, please, won't you come back?
[01:43.40]Well, this is what I wanted, please, don't feel so bad
[01:46.84]In love with a ghost, please, don't come back
[01:57.11]It's stress relief from everything
[02:03.25]Tell me, tell me you love me
[02:06.80]Come back, come back to haunt me
[02:10.21]Won't you, won't you let me be myself?
[02:24.50]Si puedes venir conmigo, amor
[02:28.03]Yo te enseño todo lo que hay
[02:31.56]¿Por qué me tratas así?
[02:35.01]Como no soy nadie
[02:53.00]Tell me you love me
[02:56.43]Come back to haunt me
[02:59.95]Won't you just let me be myself?
[03:06.72]Tell me, tell me you love me (Tell me, tell me you love me)
[03:10.18]Come back, come back to haunt me (Come back, come back to haunt me)
[03:13.76]Won't you, won't you let me be myself? (Won't you, won't you let me be myself?)
